text: dsh-clipboard-history 是面向 DSH web 客户端的剪贴板历史插件。它在 DSH host 中注册工具，并可在后台定时读取系统剪贴板，把文本变化保存到 DSH home 的历史文件。用户可以查看最近条目和预览、按 ID 取回完整内容、读取当前剪贴板、复制文本并记录，以及清空历史。历史条数和单条文本长度均可配置，适合需要在 DSH 会话中找回先前复制文本的用户；无需 API key。

dsh-clipboard-history adds clipboard tools to DSH web. It saves changing text locally and can list entries, retrieve text by ID, read or write the live clipboard, and clear history. Polling and storage limits are configurable. Useful for recovering copied text; no API key is needed.

能不能查看最近复制内容的列表和预览？
我需要把某条历史剪贴内容按编号取回来。
希望 agent 能读取我当前系统剪贴板里的文字。
让 DSH 把我提供的文本复制到系统剪贴板并留一份记录。
我想清除保存的剪贴板历史，但保留当前剪贴板内容。
I want to retrieve text I copied earlier during a DSH session.
Can an agent list and recall recent text clipboard entries?
dsh-clipboard-history 的功能「浏览剪贴板历史」：调用 clipboard_list 可按最近优先查看历史条目的编号、时间、字符数和预览，并通过 limit 控制返回数量。
dsh-clipboard-history 的功能「回取剪贴板文本」：用户先从 clipboard_list 获取条目 ID，再调用 clipboard_get 读取该条目的完整文本；找不到 ID 时会返回错误。
dsh-clipboard-history 的功能「自动记录文本变化」：启用 poll 后，后台按配置间隔读取系统剪贴板，遇到非空且变化的文本便存入有上限的历史列表，并写入 DSH home。
dsh-clipboard-history 的功能「复制并记录文本」：调用 clipboard_copy 提供非空文本后，插件写入系统剪贴板并将内容加入历史，返回对应条目 ID 和时间。
dsh-clipboard-history 的功能「清空历史」：调用 clipboard_clear 可删除已保存的历史条目并返回删除数量；当前系统剪贴板不受影响。

dsh-clipboard-history README · dsh-clipboard-history：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin that monitors the system clipboard and keeps a recallable history of
multiple clipboard entries.

dsh-clipboard-history README · What it does：- **Monitors** the system clipboard in the background (polling `pbpaste` on
  macOS, `xclip` on Linux, PowerShell on Windows) and records every text
  change into a persisted history file.
- **Persists** history across restarts at `$DSH_HOME/clipboard-history.json`.
- Exposes five tools to the agent:

dsh-clipboard-history README · What it does：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `clipboard_list` | List recent history entries (id, time, size, preview). |
| `clipboard_get` | Recall the full text of one entry by id. |
| `clipboard_current` | Read the live clipboard content right now. |
| `clipboard_copy` | Write text to the system clipboard and record it. |
| `clipboard_clear` | Clear the stored history (keeps the live clipboard). |

Then restart the web app (`dsh web`) so the new host plugin is loaded.

The `dsh plugin` command forwards to `pnpm` inside the profile directory and
reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically: because this package declares
`"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }`, it joins the profile's
patch-layer stack.

dsh-clipboard-history README · Configuration：Edit the row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or the `config` block the
bundle inserted) to tune it:

```yaml
- id: clipboard-history
  config:
    pollIntervalMs: 700   # clipboard poll interval in ms
    maxHistory: 200       # max stored entries

dsh-clipboard-history README · Notes and limitations：- Text only. Image / file clipboards are ignored (they read as empty text).
- macOS is the primary target; Linux needs `xclip`, Windows uses PowerShell.
- The plugin lives in the host process, so it has access to the logged-in
  user's pasteboard without a native addon.
